title: As White as Falling Snow
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Isaiah told a promise true,
As soft as falling snow:
"Come, let us talk it over, child" —
He wants your heart to know.

[Chorus]
So white as snow, so white as snow,
He washes hearts brand new;
No mistake is too big for Him —
His promise is for you.

[Verse 2]
Sometimes our hearts feel heavy, dark,
Like stains of scarlet red;
But sorry words can wash them all
Before we go to bed.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
When Willow said a word unkind,
She turned and made it right;
A hug, a sorry, and her heart
Felt fresh and clean and light.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my snowy-clean,
The day is tucked away;
Heavenly Father holds you close
And loves you, come what may.

[Chorus]
mood: Falling music. A slow, weightless descent under the voice — single notes drifting down and settling, the way snow lands one flake at a time and covers what was there without any effort at all. A small harp carries that falling figure and a cello underneath holds one long warm note that never leaves. It begins a little unsettled and loses its weight verse by verse, so the last line lands soft and already covered.
